assertions.title: xAI settings stay capability-aware and sanitize unsupported runtime params

steps.action: Login as val-superadmin and open xAI endpoint/model selection + xAI set-key dialog
steps.expected: Capability-aware xAI settings surface with unsupported controls read-only and explicit reasons
steps.observed: xAI endpoint/models are visible, but set-key dialog only exposes API-key field and no testable unsupported-control reason text

steps.expected: Runtime request executes so unsupported params can be verified as sanitized
steps.observed: xAI request path is blocked by missing per-user key; UI returns 'No key found. Please provide a key and try again.'

steps.expected: Resolved credential or masked saved key state

evidence.network: GET /api/keys?name=xai&includeValue=true -> 200; UI runtime attempt returned 'No key found'

assertions.issues: Cannot validate runtime parameter sanitization without working xAI credentials and a successful outbound request path.

assertions.title: xAI native web search strips only the intended generic tool

steps.action: Open xAI tools menu and toggle tool selections (File Search + Web Search controls)
steps.expected: Web Search routes natively while unrelated generic tools remain intact
steps.observed: Tool menu is visible, but runtime verification is blocked by missing xAI key

steps.action: Send xAI chat turn after tool toggles
steps.expected: Successful xAI-native web-search turn enabling strip-behavior verification
steps.observed: xAI turn fails with 'No key found. Please provide a key and try again.'

evidence.network: xAI execution blocked at credential stage ('No key found'), so strip-only runtime behavior could not be observed

assertions.issues: Native-strip assertion requires successful xAI execution; environment lacks xAI key.

steps.expected: Deterministic proof of merged source dedupe and model->origin resolution
